Open dev.twitch.tv and sign in with a Twitch account. Twitch requires two-factor authentication for developer apps: switch it on in your Twitch security settings if asked.
Open Console → Applications → "Register Your Application" (the QR code below leads there directly).
Name: anything (e.g. "GameLodge"), OAuth Redirect URL: http://localhost, category: Application Integration, client type: Confidential. Then "Create".
Select "Manage" at the new app: copy the client ID, then create a secret with "New Secret" and copy it (it is shown only once).
